chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from Ibn Bukayr, from a man, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man comes to a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship. He said: “He is to be struck one strike with the sword.”
Ibn Bukayr said: Ḥarīz narrated to me from Bukayr the like of that.

key_terms.ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ: a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship for marriage
key_terms.يَأْتِي: comes to; here meaning to have sexual relations with

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shi'i hadith on zina with a close blood relative?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who commits illicit intercourse with a woman who is within the prohibited degrees of kinship. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states a severe hadd punishment for this act, and the report is reinforced by a parallel transmission mentioned by Ibn Bukayr.
